reader.requirement: At --std 85 data-name-2's value at OPEN OUTPUT defines the first logical page's footing area, and its value at a WRITE ADVANCING PAGE or a page overflow defines the next logical page's footing area.
reader.edition-search: Same greps as GR6/GR7 over SequentialIoEmitter.cs, SequentialConnector.cs, LinagePage.cs and FileRegistry.cs: the footing slot (null when the phrase is absent) is adopted with the other three in EvaluateLinage and no edition is read.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb526 changes data-name-2 between two OPEN OUTPUTs (0 then 3); a footing change taking effect only at the next page (overflow or ADVANCING PAGE) within one open is exercised only by the probes.

probes.printed: footing 3 at OPEN, MOVE 2 after it: W01 '--' LC=2, W02 EOP LC=3, W03 EOP LC=4, W04 overflow LC=1, W05 EOP LC=2 (new footing 2)
probes.expected: first page footing area [3,4] (GR8 at OPEN), next page [2,2] (GR8 at overflow)

probes.printed: footing 5 at OPEN, MOVE 2 then WRITE AFTER ADVANCING PAGE: W05 EOP at LC=2 on the new page
probes.expected: footing at ADVANCING PAGE defines the next page's footing area

probes.printed: footing 4 > literal page 3 at OPEN: FS=90 LC=000, later WRITE FS=90
probes.expected: invalid value is a program 'must' violation (GR3), undefined

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.3.7.4 GR8  (║3.7.4 General Rules║)  the text is in GR8 [quote: it is used to define the footing area for the next logical page]

reader.notes: The footing value travels in the same LinagePage as the other three operands and is adopted only at OPEN OUTPUT and at the one page transition, so a MOVE in between affects only the next page, as measured.

refuter.evidence: rl1.cob at --std 85: footing data-name-2 changed from 4 to 1 mid-page; the current page keeps footing 4 (A5 at LC=6 EOP from the old area, nothing earlier changed), the page after the overflow uses footing 1 (A7 EOP at LC=2 where the old footing 4 would give '--'). Footing value adopted only in EvaluateLinage at BeginLinagePage (OPEN OUTPUT) and BeginNextLogicalPage (overflow and ADVANCING PAGE). cite.py: OK §1985:VII.3.7.4 GR8.
